content: Mega Think Online is Hong Kong's No. 1 online tutoring platform for Primary and Secondary students. We specialise in IB, DSE, IGCSE, and A-Level curricula. Expert tutors provide 1-to-1 personalised lessons via Zoom with interactive digital whiteboards. Flexible scheduling, free trial sessions, and monthly progress reports included.

Courses available: IB (Mathematics AA, Mathematics AI, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Economics, Business Management, English A, English B, History, Geography, Chinese B), DSE (English Language, Chinese Language, Mathematics, Liberal Studies, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Economics, M1, M2), IGCSE (English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, History, Geography, Computer Science, Economics, Chinese), Primary (English, Mathematics, Science, Common Entrance Exam prep), A-Level (Mathematics, Further Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Economics).

Browse our qualified tutors. All tutors are vetted with verified academic credentials. Filter by subject, curriculum, language, and availability. Book a free 15-minute consultation before committing. Tutors teach via Zoom with shared whiteboard tools. Rates from HK$300 to HK$600 per hour depending on tutor experience and subject. Group sessions also available at discounted rates.

Services: 1-on-1 private tutoring, small group lessons (2-4 students), exam preparation intensive courses, IB Internal Assessment coaching, Extended Essay support, DSE mock exam practice, IGCSE past paper coaching. All lessons are conducted online. Students receive recorded session replays, shared notes, and homework feedback.

Mega Think Online was founded by education professionals in Hong Kong to make high-quality tutoring accessible online. Our mission is to empower every student to reach their academic potential. We serve students across Hong Kong and internationally. Our tutors hold degrees from leading universities including HKU, CUHK, Imperial College London, LSE, and Oxford.

Contact Mega Think Online via the website contact form at megathinkonline.com/contact, WhatsApp, or email. The team responds within 24 hours. Free trial sessions can be booked directly on the website. Login or create an account at learn.megathinkonline.com.
